svg.text: 3 Proxmox nodes (Urd, Verd, Skuld) · asgard K3s on top · Synology Munin for storage · UCG-Ultra as the only firewall
DNS · tunnel edge · universal TLS cert
Tailscale, not on the home LAN
Proxmox VE cluster "niflheim": 3 × MSI Cubi · 1 GbE · VM/LXC disks on local LVM-thin · PBS backs everything up to Munin
keepalived over Saga · Mimir · Kvasir, adguardhome-sync
Patroni ×3 · etcd DCS lives on the HAProxy trio
reach the LAN from the tailnet
Skuld hard-freezes, so PBS lives on Urd.
VLAN trunk: mgmt · services · K3s · storage
asgard K3s cluster: the 6 VMs above · Flux CD GitOps (merge to main = deploy) · Calico CNI
K3s VMs (3 CP + 3 workers, spread one per host) form asgard
OIDC for apps, LDAP for SSH
- NFS share for media + big volumes
- PBS datastore (NFS, mounted in the LXC)
Sources: docs/architecture/{network,hardware}.md, docs/services/*.md, k8s/asgard/. Zone scheme: xiiisins.com (public) / midgard.xiiisins.com (internal alias) / niflheim.xiiisins.com (internal only).
Jotunheim (a second K3s cluster) was dropped on 2026-10-05; its names and ID ranges stay reserved. Jellyfin and PBS are privileged LXCs on Urd, outside K3s.
